method: 3 independent context-blind subagent runs (2x sonnet, 1x haiku). Each run received the full confusable-neighbor roster (loop-engineering, development-loop, debugging-loop, fix-loop, systematic-debugging, loop [interval runner], ralph-loop) as name+description pairs plus the 20 queries, and routed each query to one skill or NONE. No file access, no other context.

should_trigger.query: Run autonomously until the whole backlog is done — find work, do it, verify it, ship it, repeat.
Set up a self-healing loop that keeps fixing and verifying until the definition of done is met
I want a maker-checker loop where a separate agent reviews the work before anything is committed
Work through the open issues unattended overnight and escalate anything you can't fix
Run the discover plan execute verify loop on this repo
Can you triage CI failures and open issues, pick the highest value one, fix it, verify independently, and keep going until nothing is left?
autonomous feedback cycle with budgets — max 5 cycles then escalate
i want u to keep shipping fixes on ur own, with an independent checker, till everything's green
Given this DoD: 'all lint errors resolved repo-wide', run the unattended loop to completion

should_not_trigger.query: Build the user-profile feature end to end: plan, implement, verify, commit
Debug and fix this NullPointerException end to end and verify the fix
Tests are failing, iterate fix and retest until green: npm test
Check the deploy status every 5 minutes until it's live
Start a ralph loop on this prompt until the feature is complete
Refactor this nested loop to be more efficient
Set up a for-loop to iterate over these files in the script
Diagnose this flaky test — root cause unclear, don't fix yet
Add a while loop with a retry budget to the API client

summary.note: Perfect separation across all 3 runs, including the confusable neighbors sharing the word 'loop'. The description's closing disambiguation sentence ('For a single feature use /development-loop; for one bug use /debugging-loop; this is the autonomous meta-loop that ROUTES into them') is doing exactly its job.
